clue.text: Position vehicle at front door, was its message?

parts.note: to post someone is to position or station them
a car is a vehicle

indicators.note: the front of a word is its first letter, so only the opening of door is used

explanation.surface: Someone parks a car by the front door and wonders what message it brought.
explanation.walkthrough: 'front' takes only the D of 'door'. The definition leans on the question mark: the thing whose message is written on the back is a card sent through the post.
explanation.definitionFit: A holiday card carries a short written greeting, so it is the thing whose message is asked about.

clue.text: Study physical exercise plan

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercise
a ruse is a crafty plan

explanation.surface: Someone studies a fitness plan.
explanation.definitionFit: To read carefully or examine is to study.

clue.text: Secretive about one's age and with good reason

indicators.note: about means the secretive word wraps around the next

parts.note: sly means secretive or furtive
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone hides their age, and has good reason to.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting wisely means acting with good judgement and reason.

clue.text: Material obtainable with down payment — simple!

parts.note: cash paid down is money
mere means simple or nothing more than

explanation.surface: Fine cloth bought with a cash deposit: easy!
explanation.definitionFit: Cashmere is fine wool fabric from Kashmir goats.

clue.text: He makes them demigods

parts.note: put the word he in front of the answer and the result means demigods, legendary figures of more than human stature

explanation.surface: A god turns mortals into demigods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He' is not a god: the two letters set before the fish eggs spell legendary heroes.
explanation.definitionFit: Fish eggs, which with the letters of he prefixed spell a word for mythical half-divine figures.

clue.text: Horse is taken to the plant

parts.note: an Arab is a breed of horse
taken as written

explanation.surface: A horse is led to the plant, perhaps to graze.
explanation.definitionFit: Arabis is a genus of low flowering rock plants, the rock cress.

clue.text: Hordes travel to here?

indicators.note: the hordes travel, moving their letters into a new order

explanation.surface: Crowds of tourists head for a holiday island.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhodes is a Greek island, the place the anagram invites the hordes to.

clue.text: Second screen raised to allow access

parts.note: to second someone is to back them

indicators.note: in a down entry, raised means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a rood screen separates nave from chancel in a church, so rood stands for screen

explanation.surface: A second screen is lifted to let people through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns ROOD into DOOR in this down light.
explanation.definitionFit: A rear entrance is a way in, hence a means of access, often an underhand one.

clue.text: An MP sure to develop into an exceptional personality

indicators.note: develop into signals the letters turn into something else, here the answer

explanation.surface: A politician is sure to become a remarkable figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with extraordinary powers or ability is a superhuman figure.

clue.text: Make an impression with this range of voice

explanation.surface: A singer makes an impression with their vocal range.
explanation.definitionFit: To register is to make an impression or be noticed; a register is also a part of a singer's vocal compass.

clue.text: Top ace gets trounced — is now at the foot

indicators.note: a trounced side is beaten up and knocked about, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A top tennis ace is beaten and has fallen to the bottom of the rankings.
explanation.definitionFit: The reinforced cap over the front of a boot sits at the wearer's foot.

clue.text: Act about lease being taken out

indicators.note: about means the act wraps around the lease

parts.note: a deed is an act
a let is a lease of property

explanation.surface: A legal act concerning a lease is struck out.
explanation.definitionFit: Removed or crossed out text has been taken out.

clue.text: Only man without a grave

parts.note: sole means only, as in the sole survivor

indicators.note: without tells us the word man loses the letter named next

parts.note: taken as written before its letter is removed
the letter given by the word a

explanation.surface: The only man not to have a burial place.
explanation.definitionFit: Grave and serious are synonyms describing a sombre manner.

clue.text: Animal crossing swamp at brink of disaster — help needed!

indicators.note: the animal's letters straddle the others, set across them like a bridge

parts.note: a deer is an animal
a fen is a marshy swamp

indicators.note: the brink of a word is its edge, here its first letter

explanation.surface: An animal stranded in a swamp on the edge of disaster cries out for help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brink of' gives only the opening letter of 'disaster', and 'crossing' has the animal straddle the swamp and that letter together.
explanation.definitionFit: A protector who guards someone comes to their aid, so a guardian is a source of help.

clue.text: Happy lad

parts.note: the British saying 'happy as a' plus this boy, who once sold sand, describes contentment

explanation.walkthrough: The saying 'as happy as a sandboy' is British; the boy was a sand seller.
explanation.definitionFit: In the British phrase 'as happy as a ...', this boy is the byword for cheerfulness.

clue.text: Develop the way through the mountain

indicators.note: through means the way passes inside the mountain's letters

parts.note: ben is a Scottish word for a mountain, as in Ben Nevis
a road is a way

explanation.surface: A route is cut through the mountain.
explanation.definitionFit: To widen something is to expand or develop it.

clue.text: First person to take ring to West Africa for state appearance

parts.note: I is the first person pronoun
a ring is round like the letter O
WA is an abbreviation for West Africa

explanation.surface: The first person to take a ring to West Africa makes a public appearance.
explanation.definitionFit: Iowa is a US state in the Midwest.

clue.text: At last, in new, fabulous place!

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: new means these letters are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: At long last, somewhere new and wonderful!
explanation.definitionFit: Atlantis is a legendary sunken island, a mythical place.

clue.text: End somersaulting into prickly cacti — it wasn't as intended!

indicators.note: the word end tumbles head over heels into the cacti, so the two mix and are rearranged together

parts.note: cacti are prickly plants; the word is used as written

explanation.surface: Someone tumbles into prickly cacti by mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a fall, but 'somersaulting' throws all eight letters into the air together; 'prickly' only describes the cacti.
explanation.definitionFit: A mishap is something that happens without being intended.

clue.text: Happened to have been about to yield to temptation

indicators.note: about means been wraps around the next word

parts.note: been is the participle in have been
to fall is to yield to temptation, as Adam fell

explanation.surface: Someone was on the point of giving in to temptation.
explanation.definitionFit: To have befallen someone is to have happened to them.

clue.text: Instant credit

explanation.surface: Credit granted at once.
explanation.definitionFit: A tick is a moment, as in 'just a tick', and buying on tick means buying on credit.

clue.text: Broken reed had proved faithful

indicators.note: broken means the letters are smashed up and reassembled

explanation.surface: A reed that broke had nonetheless stayed loyal.
explanation.definitionFit: To have stuck to a cause or person is to have remained loyal to it.

clue.text: It's a hanging matter

parts.note: reads like a capital crime, but means simply a decorative object that dangles

explanation.definitionFit: A tuft of threads on a cushion or curtain dangles, so it is a thing that hangs.

clue.text: No pegs around, for washing

indicators.note: around means the letters are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: No clothes pegs around on washing day.
explanation.definitionFit: A porous pad used in the bath is something for washing with.

clue.text: Mischievous children fording the river to catch them?

indicators.note: fording means crossing the river, so the children's letters surround the river's

parts.note: elves are mischievous little creatures, a name for impish children
R is the abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: Naughty children wade across the river to catch something.
explanation.definitionFit: Young eels swim upriver and are netted, so they are the catch the children are after.

clue.text: Whisk silver-headed traitor off right away

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

indicators.note: off means the remaining letters go wrong and are rearranged
right is R, and away means it is removed from the word

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: A silver-haired traitor is told to get out at once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right away' takes one R out of TRAITOR, leaving TAITOR, and 'off' rearranges that to ITATOR; 'headed' puts AG at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen whisk is a device for stirring or beating, an implement that agitates.

clue.text: Large fish a trainee has to bone

parts.note: a carp is a large freshwater fish
taken as written
L is a learner, as on a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A cook and a trainee have to bone a large fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A carpal is one of the small bones of the wrist.

clue.text: A crystal box

explanation.surface: A crystal box.
explanation.definitionFit: Spar is a crystalline mineral such as feldspar, and to spar is to box.

clue.text: Belief in God is evident in these people

indicators.note: something evident in another shows up inside it, so the word is goes inside

parts.note: them stands for these people
taken as written

explanation.surface: Faith is plain to see in these people.
explanation.definitionFit: Theism is belief in the existence of a deity.

clue.text: Flush display from one couple lacking ring

indicators.note: from here means made out of, so the letters are reworked into the answer
lacking says the letter for ring is missing from the pool

parts.note: a ring is round like the letter O

explanation.surface: One couple without a wedding ring makes a showy display of wealth.
explanation.walkthrough: ONE and COUPLE give nine letters; 'lacking ring' drops one O, and the eight left are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Being flush means having plenty of money, and lavish wealth on show is luxury.

clue.text: Square sort of seating

explanation.surface: Square up for a kind of seat.
explanation.definitionFit: To square a debt is to pay it off; a high-backed wooden bench with arms is also called by this name.

clue.text: The high-ranking older woman seed retiring

parts.note: gran is grandmother, an older woman

indicators.note: retiring means going backwards, so the word seed is read in reverse

explanation.surface: Grandmother sows seed and retires.
explanation.definitionFit: Grandees are nobles or people of high rank.
